canon_ref.note: Magnolia tries to charm Erin into staying at her estate for good, using a mind-reading Skill mid-game and a rune monocle that reads Skills and Levels. Erin bites her own tongue to break the compulsion, flings a teapot in anger, then beats Magnolia outright at a fair rematch.

b2.erin_beats_magnolia_at_chess.summary: Magnolia tries to charm Erin into staying at her estate for good, using a mind-reading Skill mid-game; Erin bites her own tongue to break the compulsion, flings a teapot in anger, then beats Magnolia outright at a fair rematch.

b2.magnolia_warns_erin_of_a_coming_world.news: Lady Magnolia Reinhart is said to be gathering every stranded Earth-born soul on the continent under her own roof, and warning her own circle of a coming war.

canon_ref.note: Magnolia lists the continent's dangers - the Antinium Queens (not Klbkch or Pawn), the Goblin Lord, Az'kerash's undead, Flos's conquests - and her fear Earth weapons could tip the balance. Moved by Erin's honest answer, she sends her home, asking if Erin will act to save the world.

b2.magnolia_warns_erin_of_a_coming_world.summary: Magnolia lays out the continent's dangers - the Antinium Queens, a rising Goblin Lord, Az'kerash's undead, Flos's conquests - and her fear Earth knowledge could tip the balance. Moved by Erin's honest answer, she sends her home rather than pressing her to stay.
